en.question: Which header is required on every direct HTTP call to the Claude Messages API in addition to the API key?

options.text: accept-encoding, specifying the compression the client is able to handle.
options.note: Optional HTTP negotiation, handled by most clients automatically.

options.text: user-agent, identifying the client library and version making the request.
options.note: Useful for diagnostics but not required.

options.text: x-request-id, supplying a unique identifier for tracing the call.
options.note: Helpful for correlation; the API does not require the caller to supply it.

options.text: anthropic-version, pinning the API version the request is written against.

en.explanation: anthropic-version pins the request to a known API contract, so later API changes cannot silently alter the behaviour your integration depends on.
